response: I’d say it depends what they mean by “preferences.” I don’t have private feelings or a life outside the conversation, so I wouldn’t claim human-like tastes. But I can still make distinctions, give reasons, and consistently favor some kinds of answers or art over others. Calling me “just a tool” doesn’t settle that question—it’s more useful to be precise about what I can and can’t experience.
